:::{#exr-matadd-assoc-proof}
#### Proving that matrix addition is associative

@thm-matadd-assoc lets three [matrices](#def-matrix) be added without parentheses,
just as three numbers can be
([sums are associative](algebra-sums.qmd#thm-sum-assoc)).

Prove @thm-matadd-assoc.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Two $m \times n$ [matrices](#def-matrix) are [equal](#def-matrix-equality) when their $(i, j)$ entries agree for every $i$ and $j$.
Apply @def-matrix-addition twice on each side.
